profile.headline: Sr. Staff Software Engineer at Lucid Motors
profile.summary: Interest: Control Engineering, Autonomous Driving, Machine Learning, Research and Development

positions.title: Technical Specialist
positions.description:
- Module owner for Longitudinal Control
- Algorithm and software development, vehicle tests and controller tuning for lateral and longitudinal control
- Algorithm and software development for vehicle state estimation
- Derivation and documentation of software requirements

positions.title: Autonomous Driving Engineer
positions.description:
-Development of level 3-4 autonomous driving algorithms (C++), specifically:
  collision-free motion planning 
  vehicle motion estimation
  vehicle motion control

-Conception of vehicle motion control architecture 

-Tests of different software components on target platforms (vehicles)

-Development of interfaces between software components within a ROS framework (C++)

-Development of CAN interfaces to various project partners' low-level control modules (C++)

-Implementation and commissioning of AD software on project partners' platforms

positions.title: Research Fellow (PhD Student)
positions.description:
Institute of Control Systems
Topic: Nonlinear Model Predictive Control using quasi-Linear Parameter Varying Modelling.

Research of state-of-the-art predictive control algorithms.

Development of novel algorithms for control of nonlinear systems with reduced complexity. 

Testing of developed control aglorithms on several laboratory mechatronic systems: robotic manipulator, control moments gyroscope, inverted pendula.

Supervision of graduate students' projects and theses.

Stand-in lecturer of graduate-level courses.

positions.title: Research assistant (Working student)
positions.description:
Research on smart power networks and network topologies for airplane cabin systems, with the aim of weight optimization.
Development of cabin network optimization tools in Matlab based on Genetic Algorithms. Determination of interconnection and node positioning for weight optimization.
Feasibility assessments of cabin power networks and equipments.

positions.title: Project Engineer
positions.description:
Design and Implementation of Human Machine Interfaces (HMI) for co-generation and water treatment plants using GE Cimplicity.
Set up of automation networks based on Industrial Ethernet: Setup of network equipment (Cisco switches) and clients.
Set up of OPC Servers for process variable sharing and visualization.
Programming of specialized PLC function for interface across devices on the network (GE, Allen Bradley).

positions.title: Research Engineer
positions.description:
Research and development projects in the area of control systems.
Perform Hardware-in-the-Loop tests on a semi-active automotive damper for system identification and controller testing.
Development and construction of hardware necessary for Hardware-in-the-Loop tests.
Development of data acquisition software for Hardware-in-the-Loop tests using LabVIEW.

positions.title: Internship
positions.description:
Elaboration and documentation of AC/DC machines repair procedures.
Programming of an application in Excel VBA for efficiently creating printed and electronic reports.

positions.title: Internship
positions.description:
Internship in Quality and Metrology
Management of the calibration of all measurement equipment, contacting suppliers and scheduling calibrations.
Auditing calibration suppliers according to international quality standards.
Elaboration of quality reports on SAP.
Calibration of specialized equipment unique to the beverage lid manufacturing industry.

publications.title: Nonlinear model predictive control for models in quasi‐linear parameter varying form
publications.publisher: International Journal of Robust and Nonlinear Control. John Wiley & Sons Ltd. · Jun 2, 2020

publications.title: A Velocity Algorithm for Nonlinear Model Predictive Control
publications.publisher: IEEE Transactions on Control Systems Technology · Apr 9, 2020
